get_file_backend: get a file backend instance for local, s3, or petrel storage based on uri prefix
get_bytes: read bytes from a file path using the appropriate storage backend automatically
get_text: read text content from a file path with configurable encoding via unified I/O
put_bytes: write bytes to a file path on local disk or remote storage backend
load_dump: load or dump json, yaml, or pickle data from files across multiple storage backends
